name: iterable-operations-tests-f2b9a3e673/basic-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: 'Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported'; ballerina/lang.array lists length, push, map, indexOf, remove, removeAll, toStream, toBase64, toBase16, fromBase64, fromBase16.
Subset restrictions > Import declarations: ballerina/lang.int lists Signed8, Signed16, Signed32, Unsigned8, Unsigned16, Unsigned32, toHexString, fromString, fromHexString.
Subset restrictions > Import declarations: ballerina/lang.map lists length, keys, hasKey, get, remove.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: 'Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:' includes array:map but excludes array:filter and array:forEach; includes map:length but excludes map:map, map:filter, map:entries and map:reduce.
reason: The asserted iterable calculations depend on langlib operations absent from the explicit supported lists. In particular, testInt1 uses array forEach and int max/min/sum to produce its asserted totals and extrema; many other asserted results require array filter and map transformations/entries/reduce. One such dependency suffices to classify the whole case as feature.
unsupported_constructs: int:max, int:min and int:sum (including int method calls)
test_design_notes: main asserts results across numeric, array, map, XML, record and returned-function scenarios; supported XML map/filter APIs do not make the unsupported array/map operations supported.
io:println is output instrumentation and is not the classification basis.
